items.title: Senior React Developer
items.companyAbout: TechFlow builds workflow software for logistics teams in 40 countries. A profitable, remote-first company of 120 people with a product team of 24.
items.description: We are looking for a senior React developer to own large features on our operations platform, from technical design through to release. You will work closely with two designers and a product manager in a team that ships every week.
responsibilities: Own the design and delivery of major front-end features
Keep our component library and design system healthy
Review code and mentor mid-level engineers
Partner with the API team on contract decisions
requirements: 5+ years building production applications with React
Strong TypeScript and testing habits
Experience with state management at scale
Clear written English for a fully remote team
benefits: Fully remote with a home-office budget
4 weeks paid leave plus public holidays

items.title: UI/UX Designer
items.companyAbout: Design Studio is a 30-person product design agency working with fintech and health-tech clients across Europe, from our studio in Amsterdam.
items.description: Join a small, senior design team delivering end-to-end product work for client engagements lasting three to nine months. Roughly half of your time is spent in discovery and prototyping, the other half in detailed UI.
responsibilities: Run workshops and turn findings into flows and wireframes
Design polished UI in Figma with your design system
Prototype interactions and test with real users
Present work confidently to client stakeholders
requirements: 3+ years of product design experience
A portfolio showing shipped, measurable work
Excellent Figma skills including components
Comfortable presenting in English
benefits: Central Amsterdam studio, hybrid 3 days on-site

items.title: SEO Specialist
items.companyAbout: Growth Hub is a performance marketing team of 18 people running organic and paid programmes for B2B SaaS clients.
items.description: A part-time SEO role supporting two account managers. You will run audits, track rankings and help shape content briefs — a great first SEO job with real mentorship.
responsibilities: Run technical audits and track fixes with developers
Build keyword maps and content briefs
Report on rankings and organic traffic monthly
Support link outreach and digital PR campaigns
requirements: Familiarity with GA4 and Search Console
Strong writing and spreadsheet skills
Curiosity about how search engines work
10-20 hours per week, flexible schedule
benefits: Fully remote, set your own hours
Mentorship from a senior SEO lead
Possible to grow into a full-time role

items.title: Backend Engineer (Node.js)
items.companyAbout: Nimbus Labs provides weather data APIs to agriculture and insurance customers, serving 4 billion requests a month.
items.description: We need a backend engineer to keep a high-volume Node.js platform fast and boring in the best sense. You will own services end to end, including on-call for your own systems.
responsibilities: Design and run Node.js services handling high traffic
Model and tune PostgreSQL schemas and queries
Improve observability, alerting and incident response
Collaborate with data science on ingestion pipelines
requirements: 4+ years with Node.js in production
Solid SQL and query-performance knowledge
Experience with AWS or GCP
Comfortable with a light on-call rotation

items.title: Content Strategist
items.companyAbout: Brightwave is a B2B content agency producing research-led editorial for technology clients, with a team of 40 writers, editors and analysts.
items.description: A six-month contract to own the editorial calendar for two flagship clients, balancing search demand, sales enablement and genuinely interesting research.
responsibilities: Own quarterly editorial calendars for two clients
Brief writers with keyword and audience research
Edit long-form pieces before publication
Report on content performance with the analytics team
requirements: 3+ years in editorial or content strategy
Track record of ranking, traffic-driving content
Confident editor with a consistent standard
Available for a 6-month contract, 25 hrs/week
benefits: Fully remote with quarterly team meet-ups

items.title: Data Analyst
items.companyAbout: Marketly runs retail media advertising for 300+ supermarket brands, headquartered in Chicago.
items.description: An entry-level analyst role on our insights team. You will build the dashboards our account managers live in and answer the ad-hoc questions that shape client campaigns.
responsibilities: Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau
Answer ad-hoc questions with SQL
Check data quality and flag anomalies
Present findings to non-technical audiences
requirements: Comfortable writing intermediate SQL
Any experience with a BI tool
Strong attention to detail
Based in Chicago or willing to relocate
